paper: A fully annotated pathology slide dataset for early gastric cancer and precancerous lesions
status: Five broad group semantics and ten release color labels verified against paper Figure 1/Table 2 and released annotation description.
distinction: Group order differs from paper display order but is saved explicitly; same conceptual five-group histotype task, different model, selected cohort, patch size and training protocol. Not a benchmark replication or directly comparable score.
remaining_limitations: No expert re-review of patch labels
Upstream preprocessing code includes extra colors beyond ten-category release; unrecognized pixels excluded by our purity policy
No GrandQC mask filtering applied; artifact screening remains incomplete
